{{Top|leg}}
The '''Arakka''' was a [[River|waterway]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doshan]], near the equator. Sometime during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], [[Negastrike Platoon]] of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps']] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] was [[Battle on Doshan|deployed]] to the Arakka waterway to remove [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] colonists in preparation for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] settlement. Negastrike Platoon destroyed a Trandoshan settlement at the mouth of the waterway before deploying [[Incinerator stormtrooper/Legends|incinerator stormtroopers]] to clear Trandoshans who had taken cover beneath the river's [[Algae/Legends|algae]] mats. At least one hundred Trandoshans were burned to death in the operation.<ref name="IH">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>
